source_findings.detail: Committed diff contains only stream_overlay.ts, hud_layout.ts and hud-layout.test.mjs: 48 insertions, 2 deletions. Viewer label text remains current count plus watching.
A strict viewer increase starts at scale 1.06 if 1500 ms have elapsed since the previous onset. Scale is 1 + 0.06*(1-age/650)^3 for 0 <= age < 650 ms; otherwise 1. Cooldown measures onset to onset.

Initial previous=null returns scale 1 and clears pulse timestamp. Hidden update and goLive reset previous, timestamp and scale. StreamSession.start calls goLive for a new run. Visual lifecycle evidence still pending.

Loss never starts or restarts a pulse. Loss during an existing gain pulse retains the remaining settle and cooldown: at age 200 ms scale is approximately 1.01991. Loss at rest is neutral. Immediate neutral-on-any-loss is not implemented.

Inter/font declarations, palette, layer 7, chat, TTS, economy and combat code have no changes in this diff. Viewer scale and centered pivot can affect rendered bounds/readability; visual proof is pending.
Read existing final triangle-base logs: default root suite 13/13 steps passed and HUD unit test 20/20 passed. No test execution or independent reproduction by this auditor.

visual_gates.basis: Across every native and decoded 1:1 viewer ROI, text stays inside the LiveTube strip with clear separation from LIVE, $0, chat and hype track. No label overlap, clipping, anchor shift or center intrusion observed. Scope: captured two-/three-digit counts at 1920x1080.

Count and watching remain legible at peak and throughout sampled settles. Encoded H.264/yuv420p frames retain readable text; slight scale resampling is restrained. No alarming flicker or gross text breakup in sampled sequence. No uninterrupted temporal-stability claim.

Candidate has three bounded pulses with sampled scale monotonically decreasing from 1.05999994 to 1; no overshoot or lingering scale. Native onset frames 5,29,67 return to exact neutral at 15,39,77. Last active to first neutral intervals bracket 650ms. Source cubic duration is 650ms; sampled footage cannot time sub-frame expiry exactly.

Explicit settled loss from 197 watching to 50 watching at native frame48/3.370280s stays scale1, as do subsequent 50->49 losses. Existing organic decay during gain settles retains decreasing scale and does not restart: 100->99 at f10, 200->199 at f31, 299->298 at f70. This is not immediate neutral-on-any-loss.

LiveTube Inter stream typography/chrome remains distinct from condensed combat readouts and the late monospace trainer strip. No new tint, glow or lattice added to count. Layer7/font/palette/chat/cheat-engine style code unchanged in diff. Full cheat-engine menu presentation is absent and not visually revalidated.

Every native full-field context retains gun, iron-sight silhouette, crosshair, radar, ammo/streak areas and incoming damage/lattice presentation; the pulse is confined to the corner label. World/camera/enemy/damage timing and chat differ, so this establishes no visual obstruction from the pulse rather than pixel identity or full combat behavior equivalence.
